Version 0.1.1

- Updated documentation across all major files (README.md, SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md, etc.), clarifying pipeline steps and required inputs.
- Refined and expanded procedural steps for all audit phases, including stricter multi-step validation gates for each phase.
- Added new references and evaluation examples to improve audit traceability and test coverage.
- Introduced support materials and scripts for offline/demo scenarios, enhancing usability and testing workflows.
- Added a new publish.ps1 script for deployment and publishing support.

Initial release of grok-geo: provides comprehensive brand visibility and AI search GEO audit pipeline.

- Introduces phased, gate-driven audit process (input collection, validation, research, question mapping, search execution, analysis, metrics, opportunity generation, quality review).
- Enforces multi-step quality checklist and strict input verification before audits begin.
- Supports GEO and AI search audits across 17+ AI engines, with specialized modes (quick, standard, offline import).
- Focused on factual citation analysis, brand-competitor comparisons, and actionable recommendations.
- Excludes general copywriting, broad SEO keyword research, and content publishing tasks.
